Script.name: StaticChaos Gauges
Script.script:
-- StaticChaos GMCP status gauges (HP / Mana / Move). -- Reads Char.Vitals sent by the server's GMCP (telnet 201) and draws three -- bars across the TOP of the main window (just under the toolbar), updating in -- real time. A reserved top border keeps them from covering game text. scGMCP = scGMCP or {} function scGMCP.makeGauges() -- reserve a strip at the top so the bars sit above the text, not over it if not scGMCP.bordered then setBorderTop(36) scGMCP.bordered = true end if scGMCP.hp then return end local w = "24%" scGMCP.hp = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_hp", x="0%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.mana = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_mana", x="25%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.move = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_move", x="50%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.res = Geyser.Gauge:new({name="sc_res", x="75%", y="2px", width=w, height="32px"}) scGMCP.hp.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(175,45,45); border: 1px solid rgb(60,12,12);") scGMCP.hp.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(48,20,20);") scGMCP.mana.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(48,90,205); border: 1px solid rgb(12,12,62);") scGMCP.mana.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(22,26,56);") scGMCP.move.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(48,165,85); border: 1px solid rgb(12,52,22);") scGMCP.move.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(22,46,30);") scGMCP.res.front:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(150,90,190); border: 1px solid rgb(50,24,70);") scGMCP.res.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(40,26,52);") end local function setg(g, cur, max, label) cur = tonumber(cur) or 0 max = tonumber(max) or 1 if max < 1 then max = 1 end g:setValue(cur, max, "
" .. label .. " " .. cur .. "/" .. max .. "
") end function scGMCP.updateVitals() scGMCP.makeGauges() local v = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if not v then return end setg(scGMCP.hp, v.hp, v.maxhp, "HP") setg(scGMCP.mana, v.mana, v.maxmana, "Mana") setg(scGMCP.move, v.move, v.maxmove, "Move") if v.resname and v.resname ~= "" then scGMCP.res:show() setg(scGMCP.res, v.res, v.maxres, v.resname) else scGMCP.res:hide() end end -- (re)register the handler without duplicating it on reload if scGMCP.handler then killAnonymousEventHandler(scGMCP.handler) end scGMCP.handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "scGMCP.updateVitals") scGMCP.makeGauges() if gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals then scGMCP.updateVitals() end

Script.name: StaticChaos Mapper
Script.script:
-- StaticChaos GMCP auto-mapper. -- Consumes the server's Room.Info ({num,name,area,exits}) and populates -- Mudlet's built-in mapper, placing each new room next to the one you came -- from. Open the map with the Mapper toolbar button to watch it draw.
scMap = scMap or {}
-- our exit dir -> (dx,dy,dz) and Mudlet's direction word scMap.delta = { n = {0, 1, 0}, s = {0, -1, 0}, e = {1, 0, 0}, w = {-1, 0, 0}, u = {0, 0, 1}, d = {0, 0, -1}, } scMap.dirword = { n = "n", s = "s", e = "e", w = "w", u = "up", d = "down" }
local function trim(str) str = str or "" str = str:gsub("^%s+", "") str = str:gsub("%s+$", "") return str end
function scMap.area(name) name = trim(name) if name == "" then name = "Unknown" end local areas = getAreaTable() or {} if areas[name] then return areas[name] end return addAreaName(name) end
function scMap.onRoom() local r = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not r or r.num == nil then return end local vnum = tonumber(r.num) if not vnum then return end
local isNew = not roomExists(vnum) if isNew then addRoom(vnum) end
setRoomName(vnum, r.name or ("Room " .. vnum)) setRoomArea(vnum, scMap.area(r.area))
-- place a freshly-seen room next to wherever we walked from if isNew then local x, y, z = 0, 0, 0 if scMap.lastVnum and scMap.lastExits and roomExists(scMap.lastVnum) then for dir, target in pairs(scMap.lastExits) do if tonumber(target) == vnum and scMap.delta[dir] then local px, py, pz = getRoomCoordinates(scMap.lastVnum) local dlt = scMap.delta[dir] x = (px or 0) + dlt[1]; y = (py or 0) + dlt[2]; z = (pz or 0) + dlt[3] break end end end setRoomCoordinates(vnum, x, y, z) end
-- exits: connect to rooms we already know, stub the rest if type(r.exits) == "table" then for dir, target in pairs(r.exits) do local word = scMap.dirword[dir] local t = tonumber(target) if word then if t and roomExists(t) then setExit(vnum, t, word) else setExitStub(vnum, word, true) end end end end
scMap.lastVnum = vnum scMap.lastExits = r.exits centerview(vnum) updateMap() end
if scMap.handler then killAnonymousEventHandler(scMap.handler) end scMap.handler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", "scMap.onRoom")

Script.name: StaticChaos Tab Completion
Script.script:
-- StaticChaos GMCP tab completion. -- The server sends two one-shot lists when you log in: -- game.Commands : every command you can use (at your trust level) -- game.Chants : your chant names (Sorcerers only), hyphenated -- This script binds Tab to complete/cycle the word you're typing: -- * first word on the line -> completed against the command list -- * after "chant " -> completed against the chant list -- Matching ignores hyphens/underscores/spaces and case, so typing -- "rubyeye" then Tab finds "rubyeye-blade". Press Tab again to cycle -- through the other matches.
scComplete = scComplete or {}
-- normalise for matching: lower-case, drop separators function scComplete.norm(s) return (tostring(s or "")):lower():gsub("[-_ ]", "") end
-- store the lists as they arrive function scComplete.onCommands() scComplete.commands = gmcp.game.Commands end function scComplete.onChants() scComplete.chants = gmcp.game.Chants end
-- dir = 1 forward (default), -1 backward function scComplete.complete(dir) dir = dir or 1 if not getCommandLine then cecho("\n<red>[completion] needs a newer Mudlet (getCommandLine missing).\n") return end local line = getCommandLine() or ""
-- repeated Tab on our own output = cycle through the same matches local cycling = (line == scComplete.lastSet) and scComplete.matches and #scComplete.matches > 0 if cycling then scComplete.idx = ((scComplete.idx - 1 + dir) % #scComplete.matches) + 1 else -- split: everything up to the last token, and the token we complete local prefix, stem = line:match("^(.*%s)(%S*)$") if not prefix then prefix, stem = "", line end
local firstword = (line:match("^%s*(%S+)") or ""):lower() local cands if prefix == "" then cands = scComplete.commands -- completing the command elseif #firstword > 0 and ("chant"):sub(1, #firstword) == firstword then cands = scComplete.chants -- completing a chant name else return -- nothing we complete here end if not cands then return end
local nstem = scComplete.norm(stem) local matches = {} for _, c in ipairs(cands) do if scComplete.norm(c):sub(1, #nstem) == nstem then matches[#matches + 1] = c end end if #matches == 0 then return end
scComplete.matches = matches scComplete.prefix = prefix scComplete.idx = 1 end
local pick = scComplete.matches[scComplete.idx] local newline = scComplete.prefix .. pick clearCommandLine() appendCommandLine(newline) scComplete.lastSet = newline end
-- (re)register handlers without duplicating on reload if scComplete.h1 then killAnonymousEventHandler(scComplete.h1) end if scComplete.h2 then killAnonymousEventHandler(scComplete.h2) end scComplete.h1 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.game.Commands", "scComplete.onCommands") scComplete.h2 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.game.Chants", "scComplete.onChants")
-- seed from anything already received if gmcp and gmcp.game then if gmcp.game.Commands then scComplete.commands = gmcp.game.Commands end if gmcp.game.Chants then scComplete.chants = gmcp.game.Chants end end
